findings.label: Google OAuth timeout heuristic could fail on slow devices
findings.description: 100ms timeout before checking if GSI button element exists in DOM is not defensive. On slow devices or under JavaScript load, element may not be ready, causing silent rendering failure with no error message or fallback.

findings.label: Profile endpoint unification assumes backend support
findings.description: Both approveProfile and rejectProfile now call PATCH /status with fallback to legacy routes. If backend has both endpoints, inconsistent behavior could result. Backend endpoint availability must be verified before deployment.

findings.label: Missing backend ownership verification on case edit
findings.description: CaseEditModal checks frontend auth state but relies entirely on backend to verify case ownership. If backend doesn't enforce ownership middleware, any authenticated user could edit any case via IDOR.

findings.label: Concurrent case edit conflict detection is fragile
findings.description: Conflict detection checks if error message contains 'version' or 'conflict'. If backend uses different wording, conflicts go undetected and overwrites conflict resolution.

findings.label: Admin dashboard API failures not surfaced in UI
findings.description: Promise.allSettled tracks failed APIs in dataErrors object but doesn't render them. Admin sees empty data with no indication whether endpoint failed or data doesn't exist.

findings.label: Token logging removal incomplete
findings.description: Frontend no longer logs token substrings, but backend OAuth endpoints may still log full tokens server-side. Frontend fix is necessary but insufficient; backend logging audit required.

findings.label: GSI initialization error handling missing
findings.description: If NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is missing or invalid, button silently fails with only a console warning. Admins may not see console; should display visible error or fallback.
